title: n8n before 2.41.5 and 2.42.x before 2.42.2 passes a failed workflow's full execution context, including the identity…
description: n8n versions before 2.41.5 and 2.42.x before 2.42.2 have a vulnerability where a failed workflow's full execution context, including the identity of the user who started the run, is passed to the configured error workflow. This allows a project editor to manipulate a colleague's workflow error settings to inherit their identity upon workflow failure and access their per-user dynamic credential secrets.
